reviews.comment: Passionate professor, but not the best teacher. The class was pretty simple: 2 exams, 4 labs, and one final group project. She did take attendance as well. She was very sweet and loved when students would participate, but honestly, I didn't learn much. Easy course, but a waste of time and money in my opinion.

I love this class and Professor Ramani. Although the lectures were dull she is very helpful and always willing to answer questions. The exams were fine as long as you studied the lecture slides and lab videos. The group project is very chill, she does not give you much direction, it is graded easily. I love this class and tableau!
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the most frustrating profs I have had in Mays. Her classes are very boring and her tests are extremely hard. Would take data visualization with any other prof available if I were you.

Nandini is such a sweet professor, and really cares about her students. If you study a little bit before the exam with the lab videos, you will be fine.  Lectures are boring because she just reads off the slides, but there are in-class assignments that count for part of your grade.  Little direction on group project but graded easily.

Professor Ramani cares for her students both in and out of class. During lectures, she'll read of the lecture slides but is more than happy to answer any questions you have. The class isn't difficult nor the course material. Get ready to learn Tableau and remain on top of your studying and you'll be fine. Easy class overall.

Get ready to learn tableau! Very lecture-heavy but she was just reading the slides word for word. She grades participation and uses class time for the group project a lot so don't skip or you will miss assignments & group time. Good luck if you have a MacBook, tableau sucks on there. 1st test was over lectures and tableau, 2nd test was only tableau

Prof Ramani is great! Her MKTG 404 data visualization course is super easy! She goes over content in her lectures. She factors participation into your grade so you should attend class. You learn Tableau throughout the semester which is useful! There's a very lowkey group project at the middle/end of the semester - super easy. Two tests, not bad.
